world-title.purpose: Normal world title above 1250px; narrower layouts retain their fluid and fixed overrides.

program-heading.purpose: Wide cast and journal landmarks above 1250px; base 36px before narrower overrides.

event-heading.purpose: Retained incumbent event-heading role; the replaced house-events section uses the program heading with a 32px phone override.

dialog-title.purpose: Anton dialog headings, with 28px direct-title override on phones; resident identity headings use Manrope.

journal-copy.purpose: Base journal prose and non-conversation previews; 761–1100px previews use 12px/1.6 with two visible lines.

journal-preview-wide.purpose: Conversation descriptions above 1250px, with two visible lines; non-conversation previews retain their base treatment.

dialog-action.purpose: Primary and secondary actions inside dialogs.

resident-name.purpose: Resident identity heading, preserving name casing.

conversation-reading.purpose: Full conversation turns inside the single-scroll dialog.

navigation-wide.purpose: World masthead links above 1250px, paired with 26px icons; other routes retain shared navigation type.

motion.name: cast-hover
motion.purpose: Background change only when reduced motion is not requested.

motion.name: resident-arrival
motion.purpose: 8px vertical dialog arrival only when reduced motion is not requested.

motion.name: house-event-feedback
motion.purpose: House-event row and tone-choice background feedback; removed when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary action
components.css: .ds-primary { background:var(--action,#f4c455); color:var(--action-ink,#17284d); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); padding:12px 18px; min-height:44px; font:700 13px var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--action-hover,#e5ab33); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#284e80); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { cursor:default; opacity:.45; }

components.name: Outline action
components.css: .ds-outline { background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--text,#17284d); border:1px solid var(--control-border,#6b7b96); border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); padding:10px 13px; min-height:44px; font:650 12px var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); cursor:pointer; } .ds-outline:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--surface-hover,#dce5f2); border-color:var(--accent,#284e80); } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#284e80); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-outline:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:default; }

components.name: Native field
components.html: <label class="ds-label">House name<input class="ds-input" placeholder="Name your house"></label>
components.css: .ds-label { display:grid; gap:8px; color:var(--text,#17284d); font:400 13px/1.6 var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); } .ds-input { background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--text,#17284d); border:1px solid var(--control-border,#6b7b96); border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); padding:11px 12px; min-height:44px; font:400 14px var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted,#4b5c78); opacity:1; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:var(--focus,#284e80); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#284e80); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Directory filter
components.css: .ds-filter { min-height:44px; padding:10px 16px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--secondary,#41516e); font:700 12px var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); cursor:pointer; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed=true] { background:var(--stage,#17284d); color:var(--stage-ink,#f6f7fa); } .ds-filter:hover { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--control-border,#6b7b96); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#284e80); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Live state
components.css: .ds-live { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; background:var(--selected,#dce7f7); color:var(--selected-ink,#203f70); padding:9px 11px; border-radius:5px; font:650 11px/1.4 var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); } .ds-live i { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:#849b6e; } @media(min-width:1251px) { .ds-live { min-width:124px; justify-content:center; font-size:14px; border-radius:10px; padding:8px 12px; } }

components.name: Masthead navigation
components.description: World masthead navigation with saffron active rule and the wide-screen type variant.
components.html: The neighborhood
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; height:58px; padding:0 28px; background:var(--stage,#17284d); color:var(--stage-ink,#f6f7fa); font:650 16px var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); } .ds-nav-link { display:flex; align-items:center; height:58px; text-decoration:none; color:inherit; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current=page] { border-color:var(--saffron,#f4c455); } .ds-guide { min-height:44px; font:inherit; background:transparent; color:inherit; border:0; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav a:hover,.ds-guide:hover { color:var(--stage-ink,#f6f7fa); } .ds-nav :focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--saffron,#f4c455); outline-offset:3px; } @media(min-width:1251px) { .ds-world-nav { font-size:18px; font-weight:750; padding-inline:36px; } }

components.name: House event row
components.description: A ruled full-row dispatch button with authored content and signed starting effects. One activation sends immediately; pending, acknowledged, failed and disabled states remain explicit.
components.css: .ds-event-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:22px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:start; gap:12px; width:100%; padding:24px 0; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#cbd4e2); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--text,#17284d); text-align:left; font-family:var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); cursor:pointer; touch-action:manipulation; transition:background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-event-icon { margin-top:2px; color:var(--secondary,#41516e); } .ds-event-copy { min-width:0; } .ds-event-heading { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:baseline; gap:5px 10px; } .ds-event-heading>b { font:750 15px/1.45 var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-event-tone { color:var(--good,#38633d); font-size:10px; line-height:1.4; } .ds-event-description { display:block; margin-top:9px; max-width:65ch; color:var(--secondary,#41516e); font-size:12px; line-height:1.7; } .ds-event-effects { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:5px 12px; margin-top:12px; font-size:11px; line-height:1.6; } .ds-event-effects>span { color:var(--secondary,#41516e); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-event-effects strong { font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-event-good strong { color:var(--good,#38633d); } .ds-event-bad strong { color:var(--danger,#943f2c); } .ds-event-send { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:5px; border-radius:5px; background:var(--action,#f4c455); color:var(--action-ink,#17284d); min-height:32px; padding:6px 9px; font-size:11px; font-weight:750; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-event-row:focus-visible { position:relative; border-radius:4px; outline:2px solid var(--focus,#284e80); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-event-row:active:not(:disabled) { background:var(--selected,#dce7f7); } .ds-event-row:disabled { cursor:default; opacity:1; } .ds-event-row:disabled .ds-event-send { background:var(--surface-soft,#e8edf5); color:var(--muted,#4b5c78); } .ds-event-row.ds-event-sent .ds-event-send { background:var(--good-soft,#e4eddc); color:var(--good,#38633d); } @media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-event-row:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--surface-soft,#e8edf5); } .ds-event-row:hover:not(:disabled) .ds-event-send { background:var(--action-hover,#e5ab33); } } @media(max-width:1200px) { .ds-event-row { padding:20px 0; } } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-event-row { gap:9px; } .ds-event-copy { display:contents; } .ds-event-icon { grid-column:1; grid-row:1; } .ds-event-heading { grid-column:2; grid-row:1; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; } .ds-event-description,.ds-event-effects { grid-column:1 / -1; margin-top:0; } .ds-event-description { font-size:13px; } .ds-event-send { grid-column:3; grid-row:1; align-self:start; padding-inline:8px; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-event-row { transition:none; } }

Life in the house

components.css: .ds-panel { background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--text,#17284d); border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd4e2); border-radius:var(--radius-panel,12px); overflow:hidden; max-width:400px; } .ds-panel h2 { margin:0; padding:22px 20px 12px; font:400 36px/1.2 var(--font-display,Anton,sans-serif); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-panel p { margin:0; padding:0 20px 20px; font:400 14px/1.75 var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); } @media(min-width:1251px) { .ds-panel h2 { padding:14px 18px 8px; font-size:40px; } }

components.name: Task dialog shell

components.html:
World settings

These settings change the world for everyone.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width:min(620px,calc(100vw - 48px)); max-height:calc(100dvh - 48px); overflow:auto; overscroll-behavior:contain; scrollbar-gutter:stable; scroll-padding-block:24px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--text,#17284d); border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd4e2); border-radius:16px; box-shadow:var(--shadow,0 16px 48px #14284b26); } .ds-dialog-content { display:flow-root; min-width:0; padding:var(--dialog-inset,40px); } .ds-dialog-close { position:sticky; float:right; top:16px; z-index:3; margin:-16px -16px 0 16px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--secondary,#41516e); width:44px; height:44px; display:inline-grid; place-items:center; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); cursor:pointer; } .ds-dialog-close:hover { background:var(--surface-hover,#dce5f2); color:var(--text,#17284d); } .ds-dialog-close:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#284e80); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); font:700 14px var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); cursor:pointer; } .ds-dialog-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--action-hover,#e5ab33); } .ds-dialog-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#284e80); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-dialog-primary:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:default; } @media(max-width:600px) { .ds-dialog { width:calc(100vw - 24px); components.name: Dialog field

components.css: .ds-dialog-fields { display:grid; gap:var(--field-gap,24px); } .ds-dialog-label { display:grid; gap:var(--label-gap,8px); color:var(--text,#17284d); font:400 14px/1.6 var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); } .ds-dialog-input,.ds-dialog-textarea { min-width:0; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--text,#17284d); border:1px solid var(--control-border,#6b7b96); border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); padding:11px 12px; font:400 14px var(--font-body,Manrope,sans-serif); } .ds-dialog-input { min-height:48px; } .ds-dialog-textarea { min-height:112px; padding:12px; line-height:1.65; resize:vertical; } .ds-dialog-input:focus,.ds-dialog-textarea:focus { border-color:var(--focus,#284e80); } .ds-dialog-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#284e80); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-dialog-textarea:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#284e80); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
Kinarium puts the resident ensemble beside a live house stage. Navy frames the scene and navigation, cool white gives stories a readable program sheet, and saffron marks invitations to participate. Condensed Anton headings supply the playbill character; Manrope carries names, controls and sustained reading.

The user selected this world for the full interface redesign and approved the cast-beside-stage composition. House structure, furnishings and environmental colors may adapt to the interface; resident artwork and resident colors remain protected. The live SVG, actual residents, recorded stories and authoritative availability remain the content source.
keyCharacteristics: Navy stage and navigation, cool white reading surfaces, and saffron actions.
Anton program headings with Manrope identity, names, controls and prose.
Visible cast, adjacent story desk, and direct access to house events.
Modest corners, fine rules, flat panels, and related blue dark surfaces.

rules.name: The Resident Continuity Rule
rules.body: Preserve resident artwork and colors; change environmental materials only within the authorized house renderer.

rules.name: The Program Type Rule
rules.body: Use Anton for program landmarks and Manrope for names, controls and sustained reading.

rules.name: The Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tone, borders and space for ordinary panels; reserve floating depth for dialogs and contextual overlays.

dos: Do use the semantic light and dark roles from design-tokens.css for new interface surfaces.
Do keep the live house renderer and the original resident art and colors.
Do preserve visible focus, native field labels, pressed states and truthful disabled states.
Do keep long names wrapping and full journal content reachable behind explicit disclosures.
Do preserve observer identity, zoom, fullscreen, resident management and event access across responsive layouts.
Do honor reduced motion for optional arrival and state animations.
donts: Don't restore the superseded green/tan/Dela interface world.
Don't recolor resident sprites or replace them with generated portraits.
Don't copy sample comp dialogue, counts or availability into production history.
Don't turn directory listings and insights reading rows into elevated card grids.
Don't introduce decorative eyebrows, glyph icons or prose border stripes as reusable conventions.
